SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JEONSE_LOAN_APPLICATION WHERE APPLICATION_ID = #{applicationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JEONSE_LOAN_APPLICATION (APPLICATION_ID, USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, REQUEST_AMOUNT, AVAILABLE_LIMIT_AMOUNT, APPROVED_AMOUNT, ANNUAL_INCOME, EXISTING_DEBT_AMOUNT, CREDIT_SCORE, HOMELESS_YN, HOUSEHOLDER_YN, GUARANTEE_ORG, REPAYMENT_TYPE, LOAN_RATE, STATUS, REJECT_REASON_CODE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{requestAmount}, #{availableLimitAmount}, #{approvedAmount}, #{annualIncome}, #{existingDebtAmount}, #{creditScore}, #{homelessYn}, #{householderYn}, #{guaranteeOrg}, #{repaymentType}, #{loanRate}, #{status}, #{rejectReasonCode}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE JEONSE_LOAN_APPLICATION SET AVAILABLE_LIMIT_AMOUNT = #{availableLimitAmount}, APPROVED_AMOUNT = #{approvedAmount}, LOAN_RATE = #{loanRate}, STATUS = #{status}, REJECT_REASON_CODE = #{rejectReasonCode}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE APPLICATION_ID = #{applicationId}
